name: Image

examples.title: Aspect Ratio 16:9
examples.code:
<Image
  src="/img/bestax-solar-system-3d.png"
  alt="16:9 aspect ratio image"
  size="16by9"
/>

examples.title: Aspect Ratio 4:3
examples.code:
<Image
  src="/img/bestax-solar-system-3d.png"
  alt="4:3 aspect ratio image"
  size="4by3"
/>

examples.title: With Margin
examples.code:
<Image
  src="/img/bestax-solar-system-3d.png"
  alt="Image with margin"
  size="128x128"
  m="4"
/>

examples.title: With Iframe
examples.code:
<Image size="16by9">
  <iframe
    className="has-ratio"
    width="640"
    height="360"
    src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/YE7VzlLtp-4"
    frameBorder="0"
    allowFullScreen
    title="Sample YouTube Video"
  />
</Image>

examples.title: With Custom Child
examples.code:
<Image size="4by3">
  <Block
    display="flex"
    alignItems="center"
    justifyContent="center"
    bgColor="grey-light"
    textColor="dark"
    textAlign="centered"
    className="has-ratio"
    style={{ height: '100%' }}
  >
    <Paragraph>Custom Content</Paragraph>
  </Block>
</Image>

examples.title: With Text Color and Background
examples.code:
<Image
  src="/img/bestax-solar-system-3d.png"
  alt="Image with text and background color"
  size="128x128"
  textColor="primary"
  bgColor="light"
/>

accessibility:
- **Alt Text:** Always provide a descriptive `alt` attribute for images.
- **Aspect Ratios:** Maintains the correct aspect ratio for images, iframes, or any child.
- **Custom Content:** When embedding iframes or custom children, ensure accessibility via proper ARIA labeling or content.

:::warning
Do not use `Image` for decorative images without `alt=""`, unless purely presentational.
:::
summary: The `Image` component wraps images, iframes, or custom content in a Bulma-styled container, supporting fixed sizes, aspect ratios, rounded corners, retina images, and all Bulma helper props for color and spacing.

parts.summary: The `Image` component wraps images, iframes, or custom content in a Bulma-styled container, supporting fixed sizes, aspect ratios, rounded corners, retina images, and all Bulma helper props for color and spacing.

props.name: textColor
props.description: Text color helper for the container.

props.name: color
props.description: Text color alias: renders `has-text-<color>`, exactly like `textColor`. Not a filled variant (no `.image.is-<color>` CSS exists). Prefer `textColor`, which takes precedence when both are set; use `bgColor` for a colored surface.

props.name: bgColor
props.description: Background color helper for the container.

props.name: size
props.description: Fixed size or aspect ratio modifier for the image container.

props.name: isRounded
props.description: Renders the image with rounded corners.

props.name: children
props.description: Arbitrary content (e.g., iframe, custom HTML) inside the image container.

props.name: as
props.description: Container element tag. Defaults to `'figure'` when using aspect-ratio sizes, `'div'` otherwise.

parts.catchAll: All standard HTML attributes and Bulma helper props
